page.layout: One page of printed text in one column. A title "ELENCHUS" at the top, then topic headings in capitals, each followed by question entries with their page numbers set at the right. Catchword "DE" at the bottom right. No running head, no page number, no marginal notes.

main_text.head: ELENCHUS
DE EFFICACIA BAPTISMI.
main_text.l: QUÆSTIO XIX. An Baptismus ita tollat peccata, ut non sint, An verò

l.i: tantùm ut non regnent, & non imputentur? An tollat præterita & præsentia
tantùm, & futura pænitentiæ relinquat? An verò se extendat ad peccata, non

main_text.l: solùm quæ ante, sed etiam quæ post baptismum committuntur? Prius Neg. Po-
ster. Affir. contra Pontificios. Pag. 458
main_text.head: DE PÆDOBAPTISMO.
main_text.l: Q. XX. An Infantes fidelium fœderatorum sint baptizandi? Affir. contra Ana-
bapt. 463
main_text.head: DE SACRA COENA.
main_text.l: Q. XXI. Quid sit Sacra Cœna, & quibus nominibus præcipuè tam in Scriptura,
quàm apud Veteres insigniatur? 471
Q. XXII. Cur Sacra Cœna à Domino sit instituta, & quibus partibus con-
stet? 479
main_text.head: DE CONSECRATIONE.
main_text.l: Q. XXIII. An in Eucharistia Consecratio fiat pronuntiatione verborum Hoc
EST ENIM CORPUS MEUM, & An secretè pronuntianda sint? Neg.
contra Pontificios. 488
main_text.head: DE PANIS FRACTIONE.
main_text.l: Q. XXIV. An Ritus Fractionis panis sit necessarius in administratione Cœna?
Affir. 495
main_text.head: DE COMMUNIONE SUB UTRAQUE SPECIE.
main_text.l: Q. XXV. An ex Dei præcepto omnibus & singulis fidelibus adultis utramque

l.i: Eucharistia Symbolum administrari debeat? An verò usus Calicis Populo in-

main_text.l: terdicendus sit? Prius Affir. Poster. Neg. contra Pontificios. 500
main_text.head: DE SENSU VERBORUM SACRAMENTALIUM.
main_text.l: Q. XXVI. An verba Cœna proprie & literaliter ἐξ τὸ ῥητὸν[?], An verò tropicè &
sacramentaliter sint intelligenda? Prius Neg. Poster. Aff. cont. Pontif. & Lu-
theranos. 520
main_text.head: DE TRANSUBSTANTIATIONE.
main_text.l: Q. XXVII. An in Eucharistia detur totalis Conversio substantiæ Panis &

l.i: Vini, in Corpus & Sanguinem Christi, seu, An Panis & Vinum, vi Ver-
borum Consecrationis, in ipsum Corpus & Sanguinem Christi verè transubstan-

main_text.l: tientur, externis tantùm Speciebus panis & vini remanentibus? Neg. contra
Pontif. 546

page.notes: The Greek phrase after "literaliter" (ἐξ τὸ ῥητὸν, probably ἐξ τοῦ ῥητοῦ or similar) is set small and blurred; I am not certain of its letters, so it is marked [?]. The page numbers at the right are set on their own lines below the entry text and are copied as separate lines. The catchword "DE" is at the bottom right. No running head or page number is printed.
